sloka: सो ऽविषह्यं हि मां बुद्ध्वा स्वबलं चावमर्दितम् ।ब्राह्मेणास्त्रेण स तु मां प्राबध्नाच्चातिवेगितः ।। ५.५८.१२८ ।।।।
transliteration: so 'viṣahyaṁ hi māṁ buddhvā svabalaṁ cāvamarditam ।brāhmeṇāstreṇa sa tu māṁ prābadhnāccātivegitaḥ ।। 5.58.128 ।।।।

translations.english: "Realising that I cannot be slain and that his (Indrajit's) power is reduced, he released Brahma's weapon on me with high speed and captured me.
